sections.name: URL
sections.guide: A short note on which part of the app on this URL is affected. Do not repeat the URL.

sections.name: Summary
sections.guide: Two or three plain sentences: what the user did, what went wrong, where.

sections.name: Steps to Reproduce
sections.guide: One action per step, using on-screen labels. The last step is the observation.

sections.name: Expected Result
sections.guide: What should happen, as a requirement.

sections.name: Actual Result
sections.guide: What happens instead, matching the screenshot.

styleExample:
ACME | Admin | Orders | Order List | Export Button Does Nothing

URL: https://admin.acme.example/orders (Specifically affects the order export)

Summary: On the Order List, pressing Export shows no file and no message.

Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Orders.
2. Press Export CSV.
3. Observe that nothing downloads.

Expected Result: A CSV file downloads.

Actual Result: Nothing happens.
